name: publicWeb_resolveCustomDomain
description: Resolves a custom domain hostname to the kennel slug that should handle requests for it. Called by the Next.js middleware on every inbound request from an unrecognised hostname; result is cached in-process. Only returns slugs for kennels with Enabled = 1 — disabled kennels do not route. No authentication required.

parameters.name: CustomDomain
parameters.description: Hostname without port (e.g. 'www.decisionhall.com' or 'decisionhall.com') — exact match against HC.KennelWebsite.CustomDomain

rowsets.name: ResolvedKennel
rowsets.description: Zero or one row. Zero rows means no active kennel owns this domain — middleware should return 404 or pass through. One row means the domain resolves to this kennel.

columns.name: KennelSlug
columns.description: HC.Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName — the internal path segment to rewrite the request to

breakingChangeRules: Never change the zero-row = no match contract — middleware depends on this
Never remove the kw.Enabled = 1 filter — routing disabled kennels would expose their content at their custom domain
